name: ChangE
source:
This game tells a story about young man named Cinth, who recently moved to New York City from Maine. His only friend is a black cat, he likes reading and sitting awake at 5 am to look at sunset.
But he's not only one who likes to be up at this early hour. And this person may be the one who will change Cinth's world.

[From [url=https://skirt-gw2.tumblr.com/post/88096972355/hello-skirt-here-i-made-another-game-haha]the developer's blog[/url]]
translation:
该游戏讲述了一个名叫辛斯的年轻人的故事，他最近从缅因州搬到了纽约市。他唯一的朋友是一只黑猫，他喜欢读书，喜欢早上五点就醒着看日落。
但他并不是唯一一个喜欢这么早起床的人。而这个人，或许就是将改变辛斯世界的人。

[来自[url=https://skirt-gw2.tumblr.com/post/88096972355/hello-skirt-here-i-made-another-game-haha]开发者博客[/url]]
